Glasgow is a thriving area with strong demand for reliable full bathroom installation and fitting services. Local properties range from period Victorian and Edwardian homes through to modern new-build developments, each presenting different plumbing requirements and challenges.

Our Gas Safe registered engineers serve all areas of Glasgow and the surrounding Glasgow City region. Whether you're in the town centre or the surrounding residential areas, we provide prompt, professional bathroom installation services with transparent pricing and no hidden call-out charges.

With years of experience working across Glasgow City, our engineers understand the specific plumbing challenges faced by local homeowners. From the older pipe infrastructure common in period properties to the modern systems found in newer developments, our team has the expertise to handle any full bathroom installation and fitting requirement.

We cover all postcodes across Glasgow with same-day availability for urgent work. All our engineers are fully qualified, insured, and committed to leaving your property clean and tidy after every job.

faqs.q: How long does a full bathroom installation take?
faqs.a: A standard bathroom installation takes 5-10 days from strip-out to completion. En-suites and complex layouts with structural changes can take up to 2 weeks.

faqs.q: Do I need planning permission for a new bathroom?
faqs.a: In most cases, no. Replacing like-for-like or fitting a new bathroom within existing walls does not require planning permission. Moving soil stacks or creating a new bathroom in unconverted space may require Building Regulations approval.

faqs.q: Can you move the toilet and bath to different positions?
faqs.a: Yes, but it depends on the soil pipe route and floor structure. Moving a toilet more than a metre from the existing soil stack requires a new soil pipe connection and increases cost significantly.

faqs.q: How much does a bathroom installation cost?
faqs.a: Labour for a full bathroom installation typically ranges from £2,500 to £5,000 depending on complexity. Suite and tile costs are separate. A complete bathroom renovation including all materials typically costs £4,000 to £10,000+.

localParagraph: Glasgow's mixed housing stock — from the Victorian sandstone tenements of the West End and Dennistoun to the mid-century semis of Shawlands and modern new-builds across the expanding south side — means that bathroom installation in Glasgow requires a genuinely adaptable approach. Older properties often present challenges such as outdated pipework, unconventional wall structures, and limited space, while newer homes may demand more contemporary fitting styles and updated water pressure management. Scotland's central belt experiences mixed water hardness, which influences product selection; in Glasgow, this means choosing fixtures and fittings that perform reliably across varying mineral levels, particularly when specifying taps, showerheads, and boiler-fed systems where limescale build-up can affect longevity. A skilled local installer will assess the property's era and plumbing history before recommending suite configurations, ensuring compliance with Scottish Building Regulations throughout. Whether you're renovating a period flat near Kelvingrove or updating a bathroom in a post-war terraced house in Pollokshields, professional installation tailored to the specific demands of each property type will deliver the most durable and functional result.
whatItInvolves: A full bathroom installation covers everything from stripping out the existing suite to fitting the new one — including all pipework, waste connections, tiling preparation, flooring, and electrical work for lighting and extraction. A quality bathroom installation transforms one of the most-used rooms in your home and typically adds 3-5% to your property value.
process: The process starts with a detailed survey to assess existing pipework, drainage routes, and structural considerations. Day 1-2: strip out and prep. Day 3-4: first fix plumbing and any structural work. Day 5-7: suite installation, tiling, and second fix. Day 8-10: finishing, sealant, and final inspection. You'll be without a working bathroom for 5-10 days depending on complexity — we'll agree a realistic timeline upfront.
whatToExpect: Expect a detailed written quote covering labour, waste disposal, and any structural work. Suite and tiles are usually supplied separately by you or sourced through us. All plumbing work is carried out to Water Regulations standards. A bathroom installation is a major investment — ask to see previous work and Gas Safe registration before committing to any installer.
